elaine_fin: FYI - noticed a billing spike for customer BetaLayer during the 2026-03-04 backfill window (01:00-02:00 UTC). They flagged ~800k extra embed units. Can ops/data confirm whether this was a customer-side surge or our backfill double-ingest?

devin_data: Looking now. I ran a quick dedupe over the backfill job output. Query (ran 2189005800):

devin_data: ```sql
SELECT record_id, count(*) as copies, min(processed_at) as first_seen, max(processed_at) as last_seen
FROM backfill_embed_outputs
WHERE job_id = 'backfill-2026-03-04'
  AND customer_id = 'betalayer'
GROUP BY record_id
HAVING copies > 1
ORDER BY copies DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

arjun_replay: I traced the consumer group restart in eu-central at 2026-03-04T01:12:43Z. Kafka offset reset (caused by out-of-disk on the replay host) triggered a full reprocessing of partition 7. The replay controller retried the entire partition batch without marking already-applied offsets, so duplicates were written.

replay-bot: export ready: s3://billing-exports/2026-03/BetaLayer/backfill-2189005678.csv (per-record embed counts + hashes).

devin_data: I ran a payload-hash comparison against the export. Results: 780,400 embed units tied to duplicated record_ids with identical hashes. Another ~19,600 units are legitimate repeated attempts (different payloads) and should be billable.

nora_billing: Pricing: BetaLayer on committed plan rate $0.00045/embed-unit. If we credit 780,400 units that's $351.18. They already paid the March invoice. We'll need an approval note and audit list of record_ids (we shouldn't attach the full list in thread).

elaine_fin: Proposed action: issue a one-time credit of $351.18, update invoice INV-2026-03-089 to show adjustment, add a memo referencing BACKFILL-REPLAY-2189005678, and file postmortem with eng/replay team. Also offer BetaLayer an ops summary and ETA for fix.

arjun_replay: Mitigation: patch queued. We will (1) make replay idempotent by checking processed record_id+hash before writing, (2) persist replay checkpoints more frequently, and (3) add disk alarm to avoid OOM/out-of-disk restarts. Patch scheduled 2026-03-05 22:00 UTC.

cfo_tanya: I approve the one-time credit of $351.18 provided finance gets: short description, approved amount, list of affected record_id samples, and confirmation that revenue recognition won't be restated without finance sign-off. Please also note whether customer was notified.

elaine_fin: I'll prepare the audit doc and sample list, and I confirm BetaLayer was notified by CSM earlier today. Nora, please proceed with credit memo once audit doc is in the accounting queue.

nora_billing: Will do. Creating credit memo now and routing to AR. Memo ref: CM-2026-03-058.

devin_data: Closing note: I attached a snippet of the dedupe check we used to the ticket (internal):

devin_data: ```python
# quick dedupe: group by record_id + payload_hash
from collections import defaultdict
counts = defaultdict(int)
for row in csv_reader('backfill-2189005678.csv'):
    key = (row['record_id'], row['payload_hash'])
    counts[key] += int(row['embed_units'])
# sum duplicates where counts > original expected
```

arjun_replay: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REPLAY-1291 created for the fix.

elaine_fin: Thanks team. I'll attach audit docs to the ticket and mark this resolved after credit posts (expected 2026-03-06). :white_check_mark:
